title: Pupils, Willie's reluctance to be photographed and Bella's own picture
summary: No pupils came to the house; Willie resisted having his picture taken; his mother lived to 105; Bella shows her own photos and military-style outfit.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Did Mr. Carnish ever have any pupils that come to the house after you married him? Any pupil that learned trombone from you?
No, just them boys used to come there, but them boys with good sizes used to come there with you boys, but I don't know where they went. I don't know where they went.
And he had this picture when you were married then already?

Already, yeah. He had it pasted on something, and I tore it off, and I said, I'm going to get a picture taken. He said, don't have my picture taken. And I used to beg him to have his picture taken, you know, with his band suit on. I said, why don't you have your picture taken? I said, I don't want to buy my picture. His mama say always, and his mother never had a picture of herself, old as she was. Can you beat that? She was 105. 105 from the way we counted when he died. I have my picture. What? But I had it taken.
How old was his father when he died?
Oh, I don't know. His father was in the Spanish and in the Civil War.
Now that's my picture. I had that taken.

I've had it a good while ago. Yeah, the man who took it, he kept one. He said, I took a good picture. Well, if I put in the, if I dress up, I don't make a nice picture. But if I just put on something plain, I make, yeah. I had 12 of them tooken. And I carried lots of them away to different places and give them to my kinfolks and sent them for Easter. Yeah, everybody says, it's just like me.
Yeah. And I kept that and I said I was going to have it enlarging, you know.
You still look about that way since 70 years old.

Yeah, I'm 70 years old now. Yeah. Maybe when you see me dressed up, I don't look like this, though. I have a cape. I got regular military outfits, you know, put on white uniforms and everything. I took some flags. I have a uniform, a cap, a flower. We dress just like, like American flags.
